scope: Review-only candidate Template bound to the exact existing gallery Artwork; eight complete-character recipes with explicit ready-pose-to-held-prop path. Generated branches are preview-only and not approved.

descriptionByLanguage.en: An original chibi person with layered chestnut hair, a teal knit top, ivory shorts and light shoes, with both hands resting together.
descriptionByLanguage.zh-CN: 原创栗发 Q 版人物，青绿色针织上衣、米白短裤和浅色运动鞋，双手自然交握。

artApproval.scope: Existing gallery source remains unchanged; only the new Template and generated branches are pending review.
Review-only full-character v3 branches for ready-to-hold pose and held prop; does not approve or replace the existing Artwork.

identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One original chibi person. Preserve the same individual, facial identity, skin tone, age impression, body proportions and hand count. The original pose, hand placement, hair arrangement, garment color, expression, clothing and accessories may change only when the selected registered option explicitly names that change. Keep the complete person in a single transparent PNG; do not add another character, typography or a scene.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个原创 Q 版人物。保持同一人物、面部身份、肤色、年龄感、身体比例和手部数量。原始姿势、手部位置、发型整理、衣料配色、表情、衣着和配饰，只有在所选注册选项明确说明时才允许改变。完整人物保留在单张透明 PNG 中；不得增加其他人物、文字或场景。

semanticByLanguage.en: the original hairstyle and hair color; preserve the face, body scale, pose and outfit
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有发型和发色，脸、体型比例、姿势与衣着不变

semanticByLanguage.en: the same person with a neat short side-swept crop with a clearly open forehead wedge; preserve chestnut hair color, face, expression, knit top, clasped hands and standing pose
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 同一人物，整齐的短款侧梳发型，额前留出明显侧向分开的额头区域；保留栗色发色、脸、表情、针织上衣、交握双手与站姿

semanticByLanguage.en: the same person standing upright with the same lower-body pose, chestnut hair, face, teal knit top, ivory shorts and light shoes; move both forearms forward and apart at mid-torso, with relaxed open palms facing upward and fingers naturally curved to support a laptop; hands are empty in this option
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 同一人物保持直立站姿、下半身姿势、栗色头发、面容、青绿针织上衣、米白短裤和浅色鞋不变；仅将双前臂调整到躯干前方并自然分开，双掌放松朝上、手指微弯以便托住笔电；此选项双手保持空置

semanticByLanguage.en: the original teal knit top color; preserve skin, hair and all other garment zones
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有青绿色针织上衣配色；肤色、头发和其他衣物区域不变

semanticByLanguage.en: periwinkle knit top; preserve original skin, chestnut hair, shorts and shoes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 薰衣草蓝针织上衣；保留原肤色、栗色头发、短裤和鞋子

semanticByLanguage.en: the original open eyes and gentle smile
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有睁眼与柔和微笑

semanticByLanguage.en: two matching gentle closed eyes; preserve the original smile, face shape, hair, outfit and clasped hands
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两只对称柔和的闭合眼睛；保留原有微笑、脸型、发型、衣着和交握双手

semanticByLanguage.en: the original outfit with its fit and natural hand occlusion
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 保留原有衣着、合身关系与手部自然遮挡

semanticByLanguage.en: a fitted navy vest layered over the original knit top, following the torso contour; preserve clasped-hand occlusion and pose
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 在原针织上衣外穿合体藏青背心，沿躯干贴合；保留交握双手的遮挡关系与姿势

semanticByLanguage.en: one a fitted mustard-yellow wool beret following the hair and head perspective without covering the eyes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 贴合头顶并顺应发型和透视的芥末黄色羊毛贝雷帽，不遮眼睛

semanticByLanguage.en: a compact open silver laptop held at mid-torso; both palms visibly support the lower corners of its base, fingers contact and naturally wrap the edges, with clear hand-object occlusion and no floating parts
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 一台在躯干中部打开的紧凑银色笔电；双掌清楚托住底座下方两角，手指与边缘接触并自然环抱，手与物体有明确遮挡关系，笔电不悬浮
